sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/25 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 123 Pocahontas Campground and search/details for each of its 110 RV sites, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/pocahontas ('All campsites have electric and water hookups (no sewer)'; 'All sites accept 20 and 30-amp current; sites 66 through 129 accept 50-amp.'), read 2026-10-20; reservevaparks.com site details: 53 sites list 50-amp

values.note: Centrally located restrooms with hot showers. A 24-hour laundry (three washers and dryers) by the camp store in the campground. Firewood sold in the campground or at the park office.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/pocahontas (Camping; Laundry: 'A 24-hour facility with three washers and dryers ... is located in the campground by the camp store'; Camp Store hours), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 111 electric/water sites and 5 buddy (group) sites, plus yurts and camping cabins. DCR's page says electric/water sites take 'RVs up to 40 feet' and buddy sites up to 50; the booking site's per-site vehicle lengths run 20 to 65 ft (18 sites at 65, one at 80), with 25 pull-throughs, many in the 66-77 loop.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/pocahontas ('Total sites of each type: E/W, 111; Buddy, 5') + reservevaparks.com search/details per site (Vehicle Length, Pull in Type), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservable online by site; the booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite. Check-in 4 p.m. (site not guaranteed ready before then), check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/pocahontas + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all 110 sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed year-round camping (now on the park's own page, was derived from the AWH note) and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12). Added 50-amp electric (sites 66-129; others 20/30), water, sewer false, showers/laundry/camp store, 116 sites with pull-throughs up to 65 ft on the booking site, reservable with a 14-night max. Not stated: dump station, flush toilets in so many words, booking window or cutoff for this park, first-come policy. Note: the state:VA row still supplies opens 03-01 / closes 12-07 alongside this entry's year_round true.
flags: DCR's Pocahontas page says electric/water sites take 'RVs up to 40 feet', while reservevaparks.com lists per-site vehicle lengths up to 65 ft (18 sites) and 80 ft (site 102). max_rig_ft recorded as 65 from the booking site; EKKO fits under either figure.
Season: the entry's own year_round true sits beside the state:VA registry's inherited opens 03-01 / closes 12-07; the resolver may show both.
